title: {{list_tool}} — output
description: Output schema for the SOX list_channels (discovery) operation. Returns all channels with at least one subscriber or at least one message in the backing store's retention window (default: last 24 hours). The mandatory '_sox_protocol' block carries version negotiation metadata — clients MUST read it on first call and fail-fast if their supported version range does not intersect. Normative reference: spec/protocol.md and docs/decisions/version-negotiation-mechanism.md.

channels.description: List of discoverable channels. An empty array means no channels are currently active.

subscriber_count.description: Number of agents currently subscribed to this channel.

_sox_protocol.description: Protocol version negotiation block. MUST be present on every list_channels response. Clients MUST compare their own supported version range against supported_versions and fail-fast if the intersection is empty. If a client skips list_channels, it assumes the latest server version at its own risk.

server_version.description: The exact protocol version this server node is running (e.g. '1.0'). Semver-formatted: MAJOR.MINOR.

supported_versions.description: All protocol versions this server can serve (e.g. ['1.0', '1.1']). Clients find their intersection with this list. An empty intersection MUST cause the client to refuse to operate.

min_client_version.description: Minimum client version this server will accept (e.g. '1.0'). Clients whose version is below this MUST refuse to operate with this server.
